meta.title: x/tools/gopls: metadata is not invalidated by fixing import syntax
meta.fix_ref: golang/tools@ccb10502d1a5 (internal/lsp/cache: invalidate metadata when parsing issues resolve; CL 407501)
meta.build_notes: go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@<version> with the local Go (go1.27.1), which builds both; the server runs the local go command. v0.8.4 was tagged 2022-05-13, the fix merged 2022-05-23, v0.9.0 was tagged 2022-06-30.
meta.notes: Before the fix, gopls re-ran go list only when the parsed imports changed; an import block that went from unparseable to parseable left the package graph computed while the block was broken (without embed), so the importer reported 'could not import embed'.

files.source: issue body, first code block (the import block typed so far)
files.note: the unterminated import block verbatim (two-space indent, the empty line the cursor is on) after an added package clause 'package p' and a blank line; the issue shows only the import declaration
module path and the go directive of the era (Go 1.18, May 2022); embed is a standard-library package

repro.steps: Open main.go, whose import block is not closed yet ('import (' and '_ "embed"', then the empty line the cursor is on). Type the closing ')' on that line (line 4, character 0). Reported: the error 'could not import embed (no required module provides package "embed")' appears, because gopls keeps the package graph it computed while the import block did not parse. Probe: the diagnostics of main.go after typing are compared with a fresh session on the final text and a fresh control.

attempts.summary: First run of this attempt (2026-09-23T08:41): pre v0.8.4 present 3/3 (the case session keeps 'could not import embed (no required module provides package "embed")', the fresh session has none), post v0.9.0 present 3/3 only because the fresh session had no publishDiagnostics for main.go at all (answer None) while the case session had an empty publish ([]): gopls before v0.9.2 does not publish for a clean file on open. The harness then treated None and [] as different (verdict still-present-post, a harness artifact). The driver now answers [] for a push document without a publish after settling; the same case revision was rerun unchanged.
attempts.verdict: still-present-post (harness artifact: no publish vs empty publish)
